content:
{
    "version": 1,
    "schema_notes": "Catalog of curated animation packs and individual animations from free/CC0 sources. The Animations view renders cards from this file. Each entry's 'prompt' field is pre-filled into chat on click, the AI then guides the user through the download + import flow (Quixel Bridge, Epic Launcher marketplace, direct ZIP fetch, etc.).",
    "default_import_folder": "/Game/LocoAI/Animations",
    "sources": {
        "ue_marketplace": "https://www.unrealengine.com/marketplace/en-US/store",
        "mixamo": "https://www.mixamo.com/",
        "kenney": "https://kenney.nl/assets?q=animation",
        "opengameart": "https://opengameart.org/art-search-advanced?keys=animation"
    },
    "categories": [
        {
            "id": "locomotion",
            "label": "Locomotion, idle / walk / run",
            "icon_color": "#6ca0d8",
            "assets": [
                {
                    "name": "UE Animation Starter Pack",
                    "source": "Epic Games Marketplace",
                    "license": "Free (Epic account required)",
                    "covers": ["Idle", "Walk", "Run", "Jump", "Crouch"],
                    "tags": ["locomotion", "starter", "biped", "UE4"],
                    "description": "Epic's classic locomotion pack. 10 animations on the Mannequin skeleton, perfect starter for a ThirdPerson character.",
                    "prompt": "Guide me through installing Epic's 'Animation Starter Pack' into my project.\n\nSteps:\n1. Open Epic Games Launcher → Unreal Engine → Marketplace.\n2. Search for 'Animation Starter Pack' by Epic Games.\n3. Click 'Free', then 'Add to Project' and select this project (UE 5.5).\n4. After it lands, the animations appear at /Game/AnimStarterPack/.\n5. Retarget them to my current character (BP_ThirdPersonCharacter uses the UE5 Mannequin skeleton) via the Retarget Manager if needed.\n6. Report which animations are now available and which BP would use them."
                },
                {
                    "name": "Mixamo Idle Loop",
                    "source": "Mixamo (Adobe)",
                    "license": "Free (Adobe account required)",
                    "covers": ["Idle"],
                    "tags": ["idle", "loop", "mixamo"],
                    "description": "Single looping idle animation. Quick to grab, retarget in seconds with Mixamo's naming convention.",
                    "prompt": "Walk me through grabbing a free Idle Loop from Mixamo and retargeting it to my UE5 Mannequin character.\n\nSteps:\n1. Open https://www.mixamo.com/, log in with an Adobe account.\n2. Upload the UE5 Mannequin FBX (or use Mixamo's Y-Bot as a proxy) as the skeleton.\n3. Search 'Idle', pick a looping idle, click Download.\n4. In the download dialog: Format=FBX for Unreal, Skin=With Skin, Frames per Second=30, Keyframe Reduction=None.\n5. Import the .fbx into UE at /Game/LocoAI/Animations/Mixamo/Idle_Loop.\n6. Create an IK Retargeter if the source skeleton differs from mine.\n7. Retarget the animation to my current BP's skeleton and report the result path."
                },
                {
                    "name": "Kenney, Animated Character Pack",
                    "source": "Kenney.nl",
                    "license": "CC0",
                    "covers": ["Walk", "Run", "Jump", "Attack", "Die"],
                    "tags": ["kenney", "low-poly", "CC0", "stylized"],
                    "description": "Low-poly animated characters with basic combat + locomotion. Stylized, no attribution required.",
                    "prompt": "Help me download the 'Kenney Animated Characters' pack from kenney.nl and import one character into my project.\n\nSteps:\n1. Open https://kenney.nl/assets/animated-characters-2 in my browser.\n2. Download the ZIP (CC0, no attribution required).\n3. Extract to a temp folder.\n4. The pack has FBX files per character. Pick one character (e.g., 'adventurer') and import its FBX into /Game/LocoAI/Characters/Adventurer using Python + AssetToolsHelpers.\n5. The pack includes skeletal mesh + animations (idle, walk, run, jump, attack, die). Import each .fbx in the subfolder.\n6. Report the full list of imported assets."
                }
            ]
        },
        {
            "id": "combat",
            "label": "Combat, attack / block / hit reactions",
            "icon_color": "#c05757",
            "assets": [
                {
                    "name": "Mixamo Combat Pack",
                    "source": "Mixamo (Adobe)",
                    "license": "Free (Adobe account)",
                    "covers": ["SwordSwing", "Block", "ParrySuccess", "HitReact", "Death"],
                    "tags": ["combat", "sword", "mixamo"],
                    "description": "Collection of ~8 combat animations. Download as a single pack via Mixamo's 'Character Pack' option.",
                    "prompt": "Guide me through downloading a Mixamo combat pack and importing it.\n\nSteps:\n1. Go to https://www.mixamo.com/ and sign in.\n2. Select a character (or use Y-Bot).\n3. Search 'Sword Swing', pick 2-3 variants.\n4. Search 'Block', 'Hit Reaction', 'Death', add each to the My Animations queue.\n5. Use 'Pack' download to bundle them into one ZIP (FBX, 30fps, With Skin).\n6. Extract. Import each .fbx as a skeletal animation at /Game/LocoAI/Animations/Combat/.\n7. Retarget to my active BP's skeleton."
                },
                {
                    "name": "UE Free MoCap Sample",
                    "source": "Epic Games Marketplace",
                    "license": "Free (Epic)",
                    "covers": ["Punch", "Kick", "Dodge", "Roll"],
                    "tags": ["mocap", "martial", "ue5"],
                    "description": "Epic's free MoCap sample featuring unarmed combat moves. Clean motion capture quality.",
                    "prompt": "Install Epic's 'MoCap' free sample pack into my UE5 project.\n\nSteps:\n1. Epic Games Launcher → Unreal Engine → Marketplace → search 'MoCap sample' by Epic.\n2. Click Free and Add to Project.\n3. After install, animations land at /Game/MoCap/.\n4. List which animations are available and help me wire one into BP_ThirdPersonCharacter's AnimBlueprint."
                }
            ]
        },
        {
            "id": "reactions",
            "label": "Reactions & Emotes",
            "icon_color": "#d9a458",
            "assets": [
                {
                    "name": "Mixamo Emote Set",
                    "source": "Mixamo",
                    "license": "Free",
                    "covers": ["Wave", "Clap", "Dance", "Salute", "Cheer"],
                    "tags": ["emote", "wave", "dance", "mixamo"],
                    "description": "Fun emote animations, wave, clap, dance, salute, cheer. Great for multiplayer taunts or NPC life.",
                    "prompt": "Help me grab a set of emote animations (wave, clap, dance, salute, cheer) from Mixamo and import them.\n\nSteps:\n1. https://www.mixamo.com/ → sign in.\n2. Search each emote: 'Waving', 'Clapping', 'Dancing Twerk' (or another dance), 'Salute', 'Cheering'.\n3. Add to My Animations.\n4. Pack download → FBX for Unreal.\n5. Import each .fbx at /Game/LocoAI/Animations/Emotes/.\n6. Retarget to my character."
                }
            ]
        },
        {
            "id": "creatures",
            "label": "Creatures & NPCs",
            "icon_color": "#c38fd9",
            "assets": [
                {
                    "name": "Quadruped Starter Pack",
                    "source": "Epic Games Marketplace",
                    "license": "Free (Epic)",
                    "covers": ["Idle", "Walk", "Trot", "Run", "Attack", "Death"],
                    "tags": ["quadruped", "animal", "npc"],
                    "description": "Wolf skeletal mesh + locomotion cycles. Good base for any 4-legged enemy or companion.",
                    "prompt": "Install Epic's 'Quadruped Starter Pack' (or equivalent free wolf/dog pack) from the Marketplace.\n\nSteps:\n1. Open Epic Games Launcher → Marketplace → search 'quadruped' filtered by Free.\n2. Pick a free quadruped pack.\n3. Add to this project.\n4. After install, list the animations and skeletal mesh paths.\n5. Create a BP_WolfNPC actor wrapping the skeletal mesh + a basic AnimBlueprint with an Idle→Walk blend."
                }
            ]
        }
    ],
    "legal_notes": [
        "Only assets with commercial-use-allowed licenses are listed (CC0, Mixamo free tier, UE Marketplace free assets).",
        "Some sources require an account (Epic Games, Adobe), that is a one-time step per developer.",
        "License text per asset is the responsibility of the downloader to preserve and attribute where required (Kenney = CC0, no attribution; Mixamo = free with Adobe ToS; UE assets = UE EULA)."
    ]
}
